item.title: Critical Orkes Conductor Vulnerability Exploited in Attacks
item.description: CVE-2026-58138 is an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability that attackers can exploit via inline workflow definitions. The post Critical Orkes Conductor Vulnerability Exploited in Attacks appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: Lexiang Aether Embodied Model Runs Hour-Plus Outdoor BBQ Robot Livestream
item.description: Lexiang Technology's ~4B Aether model—trained on ~200h human video and 0 real-robot data—drove dual humanoids through a 1h+ outdoor BBQ service livestream in Shanghai as a public cross-embodiment stress test.

item.title: Xiaomi Livestreams MiMo-V2.6 Pro and Flash RL Post-Training Dashboard
item.description: Xiaomi MiMo publicly streams MiMo-V2.6 Pro/Flash reinforcement-learning post-training—steps, tokens, rewards, and cost—at mimo.xiaomi.com/rl/, a rare open view of agent RL at scale.

item.title: Zhipu Opens GLM-5.3-FlashX Near 200 Tokens/s on ~100k Domestic Accelerators
item.description: Zhipu AI launched GLM-5.3-FlashX with claimed ~200 tok/s inference on ~100,000 domestic accelerators; Flash base is a 320B MoE/18B active open model, with an Infra Agent optimizing the serving stack.

item.title: CXMT Plans Beijing NAND Flash R&D Line as DRAM Leader Eyes YMTC's Turf
item.description: CXMT is preparing a Beijing NAND flash R&D production line amid a global memory shortage, expanding the DRAM leader into YMTC's flash segment in China's dual-star storage lineup.

item.title: MIND Secures $72 Million for AI-Powered DLP
item.description: The company will use the funding to accelerate platform development and expand its presence in key enterprise markets. The post MIND Secures $72 Million for AI-Powered DLP appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: Check Point, Kaspersky, Tanium Patch Product Vulnerabilities
